# Legacy stage units prim

Unprefixed stage units on the stage-info [prim](glossary.md#prim) of older and controlled Stages. The consumer reads them only when the root prim carries none of the stage_units columns.

- **Scope:** stage, prim `/__ovstage_population_stage_info__`

## What USD population writes

The current producer never writes this prim; older ovpopulation builds and controlled test populators author the three columns on it. /__ovpopulation_stage_info__ is accepted as an older location with the same column names, read only when /__ovstage_population_stage_info__ provides none of them.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Required | Producer writes | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `metersPerUnit` | float64 | no | not written | 1.0 ([SI](glossary.md#si)) unless the root prim's usd-metadata:metersPerUnit applies. Any dtype other than float32/float64 is ignored as if absent. |
| `kilogramsPerUnit` | float64 | no | not written | 1.0 (SI) unless the root prim's usd-metadata:kilogramsPerUnit applies. |
| `upAxis` | uint64, TOKEN_ID | no | not written | Z-up unless the root prim's usd-metadata:upAxis applies. Only the token Y selects Y-up. |

## Notes

- Precedence is per prim, not per column: the first location that yields any of the three values, in the order root prim (usd-metadata: names), /__ovstage_population_stage_info__, /__ovpopulation_stage_info__, supplies all units; columns it lacks keep their SI defaults.
- Read once when the consumer's source is constructed, like the stage_units block.
